title: OpenCode turnstile configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/opencode/turnstile.json. Every key is optional and falls back to the code defaults in src/config.ts; a missing key is never an error. The $schema key itself is silently ignored at load (it is the editor convention pointing at this file). Markers and regex sources (gateMarker, verdictMarker, evidencePattern, the toolPolicy/gitGates regex lists, commitFormat) are strings; their compile check happens at merge time, not here.

metricsDir.description: Directory for both telemetry files; must be an absolute path (not expanded). Computed at load time when omitted.

journalMaxBytes.description: Rotate a journal file past this many bytes (default 5242880).

journalMaxGenerations.description: Number of rotated journal generations to keep (default 5).

replayTailLines.description: Journal lines replayed per boot from the current + .1 generations (default 2000).

maxTotalDispatches.description: Total task/subagent dispatches per task, the global loop backstop (default 16).

readWarn.description: Whole-file read count at which the horizon warning is injected (default 8).

readBlock.description: Whole-file read count at which further reads are blocked (default 15).

waiverMarker.description: Literal marker that waives the reviewer gate when in the prompt (default USER WAIVER:).

approvalMarker.description: Literal prompt-channel plan-approval marker (default PLAN APPROVED:).

plansDir.description: Project-relative directory scanned for ## Decomposition plans (default .opencode/plans).

trace.description: Write the human-readable trace file (JSONL journal always writes) (default true).

continuationCarry.description: Carry the task's gate flags across a prompt reset when the worktree/branch is unchanged, instead of starting a clean cycle (default false).

agents.description: Agent names turnstile recognizes in dispatches.

bareOutput.description: Agents contracted to emit GATE/VERDICT markers (default [test-runner, reviewer, plan-reviewer]).

gateMarker.description: Gate marker regex source, compiled with gm.

verdictMarker.description: Verdict marker regex source, compiled with gm.

gateEvidence.description: Evidence-correlation mode for the reviewer gate (default enforce).

reviewEnsemble.description: Enforcement mode for the reviewer ensemble (default enforce).

evidencePattern.description: Case-insensitive regex source matched against bash/shell commands to count as test-execution evidence.

toolPolicy.description: Denylist policy for bash/shell and write/edit tools in execute.before.

bashDeny.description: Case-insensitive regex sources matched against bash/shell commands (default empty).

pathDeny.description: Case-insensitive regex sources matched against write/edit target paths (default empty).

observeSessionMove.description: Journal session_move dispatches as telemetry (default true).

gitGates.description: Git-and-commit gate configuration (default mode shadow, audit-only).

commitMessages.description: Whether git commit messages are linted as conventional commits (default true).

commitFormat.description: Conventional-commit regex source (compiled ^...$ with s) matched against each subject.

landingGate.description: Whether pushing/PR-landing is gated on a reviewer VERDICT: APPROVE (default true).
